info.title: Extreme Platform ONE REST API - Performance Monitoring
info.description:
Build real-time performance monitoring and analytics experiences with the
Extreme Platform ONE Performance API. Discover metric metadata dynamically,
retrieve the latest operational state, analyze trends over time, and compare
performance across the dimensions that matter to your business.

servers.description: Extreme Platform ONE REST API - Performance Monitoring

tags.name: Metadata
tags.description:
Discover the metadata foundation for dynamic, efficient analytics. Explore
entity types, dimensions, metric groups, metrics, supported aggregations,
and data-resolution and retention tiers before building a query.

tags.name: Device CPU Metrics
tags.description:
Monitor per-core CPU performance across your device fleet. Track total,
user, and system utilization to identify hotspots, compare devices, and
accelerate performance troubleshooting.

**Canonical metric group:** `device-cpu-stats`

**Associated entity type:** Device CPU

**Canonical entity type:** `device-cpu`

**Entity key:** `device_id`, `cpu_core`

tags.name: Device Interface Metrics
tags.description:
Turn interface telemetry into actionable network insight. Analyze traffic,
utilization, and errors to compare interfaces, surface bottlenecks, and
protect service quality.

**Canonical metric group:** `device-interface-stats`

**Associated entity type:** Device Interface

**Canonical entity type:** `device-interface`

tags.name: Device Metrics
tags.description:
Build a unified view of device health and operational performance. Track
memory, temperature, client load, and uptime to prioritize issues and make
faster, data-driven decisions.

**Canonical metric group:** `device-stats`

**Associated entity type:** Device

**Canonical entity type:** `device`

get.description: Choose an efficient, supported time-series resolution by retrieving the minimum aggregation interval in seconds for a requested range. Specify either last or start_time with an optional end_time; the two range styles are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: metric_group
parameters.description: Metric group name.

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: Relative lookback window, such as 30m, 24h, or 7d. Mutually exclusive with start_time/end_time.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Inclusive range start in RFC 3339 format. Required when last is not provided.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Exclusive range end in RFC 3339 format. Defaults to current time when omitted.

name.description: Machine-readable dimension name used in analytics requests.

key.description: Indicates whether the dimension forms part of the key that uniquely identifies an entity. Multiple dimensions can be marked as key dimensions for a composite key.

dimensions.description: Dimensions associated with the entity type.

TimeRange.description: Time range specified as either a relative lookback or an absolute interval.

RelativeTimeRange.title: Relative time range
RelativeTimeRange.description: Defines a time range using a lookback duration relative to the current time.

AbsoluteTimeRange.title: Absolute time range
AbsoluteTimeRange.description: Defines a time range using explicit RFC 3339 timestamps.

end_time.description: Defaults to current time when omitted.

AggregationInterval.description: Aggregation interval in seconds. A requested value must be an integer multiple of the minimum supported interval for the requested time range.

CardinalityEstimationMode.description: Controls how group cardinality is evaluated. auto allows the service to choose the safest method for the request; approximate favors a bounded-memory estimate; exact requests an exact count and may be rejected when it exceeds the service's resource-safety limits.

CardinalityEstimationMethod.description: Method used to calculate the returned cardinality.

estimated_cardinality.description: Estimated number of distinct groups produced by the request.

max_cardinality.description: Maximum group cardinality currently allowed by the service.

status.description: Advisory decision based on the estimated cardinality and current service limit.

SiteId.description: Unique identifier for the site associated with the device.

CpuCore.description: Zero-based logical CPU core index. Together with device_id, this dimension forms the composite device-cpu entity key.

size.description: Maximum number of items to return in a single page. The service may return fewer items than requested.

token.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the previous page.

include_total.description: Set to true to include the total number of matching items in the pagination response. Defaults to false to avoid the additional backend processing required to calculate the total.

total.description: Total number of matching items when requested using include_total.

dimensions.description: Dimensions available in the metric group.

metrics.description: Metrics available in the metric group.

MetricType.description:
Semantic behavior of the metric value:

- `gauge`: A point-in-time value that may increase or decrease.
- `counter`: A cumulative value that increases until it resets.

kind.description: Indicates whether the tier contains raw samples or aggregated rollup data.

resolution_seconds.description: Granularity of the stored data in seconds.

retention_days.description: Number of days for which data in this tier is retained.

unit.description: Canonical unit symbol for the metric. Uses UCUM notation where applicable.

DeviceCpuStatsFilters.description: Filters to apply. Multiple filters are combined using AND semantics.

cpu_utilization.description: Total utilization percentage for the CPU core.

cpu_user_utilization.description: User-space utilization percentage for the CPU core.

cpu_system_utilization.description: System utilization percentage for the CPU core.

fields.description: Fields to include in each response item. When omitted, all dimensions and metrics are returned. The timestamp field is always returned.

DeviceInterfaceStatsFilters.description: Filters to apply. Multiple filters are combined using AND semantics.

rx_bps.description: Receive throughput in bits per second.

tx_bps.description: Transmit throughput in bits per second.

fields.description: Fields to include in each response item. When omitted, all dimensions and metrics are returned. The timestamp field is always returned.

DeviceStatsFilters.description: Filters to apply. Multiple filters are combined using AND semantics.

fields.description: Fields to include in each response item. When omitted, all dimensions and metrics are returned. The timestamp field is always returned.
